from.place: Proof of the qcqs proper/open realization, construction and finite comparison

title: Completeness and finite mates of ambient qcqs compact support
statement: For a prime ell invertible in a field K0, a finite coefficient extension E/Q_ell, finite-type K0-schemes X,Y and a separated finite-type K0-morphism f with fixed compactification c, the actual completed proper/open image of any integral constructible input K is derived complete. Every actual scalar-adjunction mate from that image reduced modulo the positive power n+1 to finite-coefficient proper/open image of the reduced K is invertible. Constructibility, completion, reduction and compact support are the constructions of [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-integral-derived-reduction, def-weil-compactifications-refinements, def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed].

lean.statement:
theorem sfQcqsCompactSupport_finiteComparison
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) :
    IsSfDerivedComplete l E Y ((image (completed l E) c).obj K.obj) ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso
        ((comparison (reduction l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)) c).app K.obj)
